def solve(case):
    from collections import defaultdict
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = case['required_symbols']
    node_map = {}
    children_of = defaultdict(list)
    for node in nodes:
        nid = node['id']
        node_map[nid] = node
        parent = node.get('parent')
        if parent is not None:
            children_of[parent].append(nid)
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    removed = []
    candidates = []
    for nid, node in node_map.items():
        if node['removable'] and node['symbol'] not in required_symbols and nid != 'root':
            candidates.append((node['depth'], nid))
    candidates.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1]))  # depth descending, id ascending
    for depth, nid in candidates:
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        children = children_of.get(nid, [])
        if any(child in retained for child in children):
            continue
        retained.remove(nid)
        required_ok = True
        for sym in required_symbols:
            found_any = False
            for rid in retained:
                if node_map[rid]['symbol'] == sym:
                    found_any = True
                    break
            if not found_any:
                required_ok = False
                break
        if required_ok:
            removed.append(nid)
        else:
            retained.add(nid)
    retained_node_ids = sorted(retained)
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed, "retained_node_ids": retained_node_ids}
